==English== {{wp}} ===Etymology=== {{root|en|ine-pro|*pewH-}} 14c. "credit, good reputation", from {{inh|en|enm|reputacion,reputacioun,reputation,reputatioun}}, from {{der|en|xno|reputacion,reputacioun}}, {{der|en|frm|reputation}} ({{cog|fr|réputation}}), and their etymon {{der|en|la|reputātiō|reputātiōnem|consideration, thinking over}}, noun of action from past participle stem of {{m|la|reputō||reflect upon, reckon, count over}}, from the prefix {{m|la|re-||again}} + {{m|la|putō||reckon, consider}}.{{R:OED Online|pos=n|id=3841453951}} {{surf|en|repute|-ation}}. Displaced native {{ncog|ang|hlīsa||reputation, fame}} ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/ˌɹɛpjʊˈteɪʃən/}} * {{audio|en|en-us-reputation.ogg|a=US}} * {{rhymes|en|eɪʃən|s=4}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun|~}} # What somebody or something is [[known]] for. #: {{synonyms|en|name|character|charctersavour|face|standing|stock}} #: {{ux|en|The new manager has a '''reputation''' for being a stickler for details.}} #* {{quote-book |en |year=1529 |author=John Frith |by= |title=A pistle to the Christen reader. The Revelation of Antichrist: Antithesis, {{...}} |url=http://books.google.com/books?id=Vb07AAAAcAAJ&pg=PT117 |chapter= |isbn= |publisher=Luft [i.e. Hoochstraten] |location= |editor= |volume_plain= |page=117 |passage=And Balaam (or as the trueth of the hebrewe hath Bileam) doth signifie the people of no '''reputation'''
or the vayne people or they that are not counted for people. }} #* {{quote-book |en |year=1928 |author=w:Franklin D. Roosevelt |title=The Happy Warrior Alfred E. Smith |url=https://archive.org/details/happywarrioralfr006717mbp/ |publisher=w:Houghton Mifflin |oclc=769015 |page=12 |pageurl=https://archive.org/details/happywarrioralfr006717mbp/page/n23/ |text=Sometimes a man makes a '''reputation''', deserved or otherwise, by a single action.}} #* {{RQ:Guardian|author=Stephen Curry|title=Why the Higher Education and Research Bill must be amended|url=https://www.theguardian.com/science/occams-corner/2016/oct/18/higher-education-research-bill-needs-amended|date=2016-10-18|passage=The '''reputations''' of our universities and our
